title: Secret Dice
description:
Combine dice and items to create powerful synergies and unique builds. Secret Dice is a roguelike strategy game where every run plays out differently. Roll, combine, and stack your score as you push for new heights.

It's not just luck. The choices you make — which dice to pick, which items to use — determine the outcome. Recruit new dice from the shop, build your own strategy, and discover new possibilities with every attempt.

The familiar rules of Yacht Dice meet the depth of deckbuilding strategy. Within the simple act of choosing and rolling dice, dozens of synergies and combos can explode into action. The same dice can produce completely different results depending on which items you pair them with.

20+ Unique Dice — From basic dice to rare ones with special effects, over 20 dice each with their own distinct abilities await you. The combination of dice you encounter changes every run, so every attempt calls for a brand new strategy.

100+ Items to Complete Your Build — The items you purchase from the shop define the direction of your build. Score multipliers, combo enhancers, and over 100 items in total open up endless build possibilities.

Every Run is Different — Thanks to the randomly generated run structure, no two playthroughs are ever the same. Which dice you encounter and which items appear in the shop make every attempt a completely unique experience.

Multiple Rule Sets to Choose From — Don't be locked into one way of playing. Choose from a variety of rule sets to take on new challenges that match your playstyle.
description_short: Roll dice, combine items, and unleash powerful synergies in this roguelike strategy game. With 20+ unique dice and 100+ items, build a brand-new strategy every run. The same dice can yield completely different results depending on your items. It's not luck — it's strategy!
